name: Do no harm
description: Anticipate, assess, and mitigate human rights harms across the full DPI life cycle.
sourceCitation: UN DPI Safeguards Framework, Foundational Principles — https://digitalpublicinfrastructure.ai/safeguards.php

name: Do not discriminate
description: Ensure unbiased access and equal opportunity for all individuals regardless of intersecting identities.
sourceCitation: UN DPI Safeguards Framework, Foundational Principles — https://digitalpublicinfrastructure.ai/safeguards.php

name: Do not exclude
description: Provide a choice of channels — digital and non-digital — based on individual capacity. Access must not be conditional or mandatory.
sourceCitation: UN DPI Safeguards Framework, Foundational Principles — https://digitalpublicinfrastructure.ai/safeguards.php

name: Reinforce transparency and accountability
description: Develop DPI with democratic participation, public oversight, and fair market competition. Avoid vendor lock-in.
sourceCitation: UN DPI Safeguards Framework, Foundational Principles — https://digitalpublicinfrastructure.ai/safeguards.php

name: Uphold the rule of law
description: Introduce DPI with a clear legal basis and embed regulatory aspects into its design from the outset.
sourceCitation: UN DPI Safeguards Framework, Foundational Principles — https://digitalpublicinfrastructure.ai/safeguards.php

name: Promote autonomy and agency
description: Enable everyone to take control of their data, exercise choice, and contribute to their society's well-being.
sourceCitation: UN DPI Safeguards Framework, Foundational Principles — https://digitalpublicinfrastructure.ai/safeguards.php

name: Foster community engagement
description: Centre all life cycle stages on the needs and interests of individuals and communities at risk.
sourceCitation: UN DPI Safeguards Framework, Foundational Principles — https://digitalpublicinfrastructure.ai/safeguards.php

name: Ensure effective remedy and redress
description: Complaint response, avenues for appeal, and grievance mechanisms must be accessible to all, equitably.
sourceCitation: UN DPI Safeguards Framework, Foundational Principles — https://digitalpublicinfrastructure.ai/safeguards.php

name: Focus on future sustainability
description: Anticipate and limit long-term harms. Mitigate environmental impact and minimise resource needs.
sourceCitation: UN DPI Safeguards Framework, Foundational Principles — https://digitalpublicinfrastructure.ai/safeguards.php

name: Leverage market dynamics
description: Foster inclusive public and private innovation so market players can compete and address emerging needs.
sourceCitation: UN DPI Safeguards Framework, Operational Principles — https://digitalpublicinfrastructure.ai/safeguards.php

name: Evolve with evidence
description: Independent, transparent, continuous assessments and audits — rapidly cease or initiate activities based on evidence.
sourceCitation: UN DPI Safeguards Framework, Operational Principles — https://digitalpublicinfrastructure.ai/safeguards.php

name: Ensure data privacy by design
description: Embed data minimization, provisions to delink, and ability to limit observability into legal and technical architecture.
sourceCitation: UN DPI Safeguards Framework, Operational Principles — https://digitalpublicinfrastructure.ai/safeguards.php

name: Assure data security by design
description: Incorporate encryption and pseudonymization. Legal frameworks should fill gaps where technical design is insufficient.
sourceCitation: UN DPI Safeguards Framework, Operational Principles — https://digitalpublicinfrastructure.ai/safeguards.php

name: Ensure data protection during use
description: Process or retain personal data lawfully and transparently only by authorized personnel within a legal framework.
sourceCitation: UN DPI Safeguards Framework, Operational Principles — https://digitalpublicinfrastructure.ai/safeguards.php

name: Respond to gender, ability or age
description: DPI must not exacerbate existing challenges or introduce new barriers for those facing structural inequalities.
sourceCitation: UN DPI Safeguards Framework, Operational Principles — https://digitalpublicinfrastructure.ai/safeguards.php

name: Practice inclusive governance
description: Establish a robust legal, regulatory, and institutional framework promoting transparent multi-stakeholder governance.
sourceCitation: UN DPI Safeguards Framework, Operational Principles — https://digitalpublicinfrastructure.ai/safeguards.php

name: Sustain financial viability
description: Establish diversified, phased, and sustainable financing models. Governments lead build; partners lead operations.
sourceCitation: UN DPI Safeguards Framework, Operational Principles — https://digitalpublicinfrastructure.ai/safeguards.php

name: Build and share open assets
description: Share and reuse open protocols, specifications, and DPGs to prevent proprietary systems from limiting safety.
sourceCitation: UN DPI Safeguards Framework, Operational Principles — https://digitalpublicinfrastructure.ai/safeguards.php
